item.title: A partial reopening of the Strait of Hormuz appears close
item.description: Mediators say Iran and Oman are close to an agreement to partially reopen shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. The US has also signaled a deal could be close.
item.content:encoded: Mediators say Iran and Oman are close to an agreement to partially reopen shipping through the Strait of Hormuz. The US has also signaled a deal could be close.
item.dc:creator: Hadeel Al-Shalchi

item.title: Greetings from a wildlife park in central Sri Lanka that's a haven for elephants
item.description: At a time of increased conflict between elephants and humans, as elephant habitats are converted to intensive agriculture, the Hurulu Eco Park is a place where the animals can graze unimpeded.
item.content:encoded: At a time of increased conflict between elephants and humans, as elephant habitats are converted to intensive agriculture, the Hurulu Eco Park is a place where the animals can graze unimpeded.

item.title: This country is the latest to hit the elusive 95/95/95 HIV target
item.description: The United Nations has set a goal for near universal HIV diagnosis and treatment for all by 2030. No country in Asia has hit the mark — until this year.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Gianni Infantino gets internal support at crisis meeting to remain as FIFA president
item.description: FIFA said Wednesday it had apologized for errors made over Gianni Infantino's failed plan to sell stakes in the World Cup and that senior staff in attendance at a crisis meeting in Morocco "reaffirmed their full support" for his presidency.
item.content:encoded:
FIFA said Wednesday it had apologized for errors made over Gianni Infantino's failed plan to sell stakes in the World Cup and that senior staff in attendance at a crisis meeting in Morocco "reaffirmed their full support" for his presidency.

(Image credit: STR/AP Photo)

item.title: Drone with explosives found at German airport, official sees 'new quality' of threat
item.description: Regional police and prosecutors said an airport employee discovered a drone near the airport's south runway with "an unknown explosive device," and the object was examined by police

item.title: Ousted Bangladeshi leader vows to return from exile despite facing a death sentence
item.description: Hasina's speech marked the second anniversary of her ouster. She fled Bangladesh by helicopter following nearly two months of protests in 2024 that left nearly 1,400 people dead, according to the United Nations.

item.title: Kyiv residents face attacks with fewer defenses overhead
item.description: Another overnight attack killed at least 17 people in and around Kyiv. The strikes come as Ukraine faces a growing shortage of the interceptor missiles used to defend the capital.

item.title: Pakistan's ruling party leads in Kashmir vote despite boycott call by banned group
item.description: Candidates backed by twice-elected former Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif's Pakistan Muslim League-N party have won 24 of the 34 seats decided in the first two phases of voting, the election commission, said Wednesday.
item.content:encoded:

item.description: A 73-year-old retired nurse's decision to learn to write Tibetan language offers a glimpse into how some embrace their language and cultural identity in Tibet.

item.title: U.S. missile stockpiles dwindle. And, FDA weighs approval of flu shots with mRNA tech
item.description: The U.S. Army's missile stockpile is dwindling and could take years to replenish. And, the Food and Drug Administration is deciding whether to approve a flu vaccine with mRNA technology.
